name: Joah
overview: Joah was a male Levite known as the third-born son of Obed-edom. His mention in Scripture is brief, identifying him primarily by his birth order within his family. There are no additional notes or details about his life or activities beyond this familial designation.
namesAndTitles: The name Joah means "y-h-v-h is brother," reflecting a theophoric element common in Hebrew names that acknowledges the Lord. This single proper name does not carry additional titles or designations in the biblical record.
familyAndRelationships: Joah is explicitly recorded as the son of Obed-edom, situating him within a family of Levites. Scripture does not provide further family relationships beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Joah's significance lies in his identification as a Levite and a descendant of Obed-edom, a family entrusted with duties related to the house of the Lord. Although minimal information is given, his inclusion in the genealogical record underscores the faithfulness of the Levitical lineage in serving God’s purposes during the time chronicled.
